# KAHRELUM: full public research and service context

> Canonical domain: https://kahrelum.com. This file summarizes the public site for indexing and research assistants. It is not a machine-action API and creates no customer, contracting, or access entitlement.

## Business identity and scope
KAHRELUM offers independent, operator-assisted evidence-to-decision reviews and maintains public-source investigations, forecasting research and evaluation demonstrations. It separates facts from inference and speculation, preserves cutoff timestamps, records uncertainty and keeps failed or unresolved tests visible. The public site does not claim accreditation, universal superior performance, guaranteed forecast accuracy, production access, or authenticated private data.

Official website: https://kahrelum.com/
Public source repository: https://github.com/AuroraGrid/kahrelum-os
AI and agent assurance: https://kahrelum.com/assurance
Commercial packages: https://kahrelum.com/pilot

## Fixed commercial scopes
Fit Check: $750 paid upfront, one workflow, exactly three approved, appropriately de-identified closed historical decisions, one-page most-consequential-gap and FIT / NO FIT report. Target delivery is two business days after mutually agreed written scope, permitted usable inputs and cleared payment. Full $750 credit toward a $2,500 Founding Pilot started within 14 days.

Founding Pilot: $2,500 paid upfront, one workflow and up to ten authorized, appropriately de-identified closed historical decisions, per-case evidence-to-decision records, consolidated report and readout call. Target five business days after scope/protocol freeze, permitted inputs and cleared payment.

No direct checkout is offered. The public form prepares an email for a visitor to review and send; it is not an automated server submission. Do not provide confidential data, credentials or unapproved customer material through the public inquiry. Existing recipient-specific quotes remain intact and are not a third public package.

NFL deadline watch: https://kahrelum.com/nfl/deadline-watch-2026

Research artifacts preserve historical source editions, original forecast locks, corrections and unresolved evidence. Election calls are not official certifications; historical forecasts are not revised after outcomes. NFL source observations are not confirmed transactions without official verification. Candidate portraits require correct identity matching and lawful reuse rights before publication.

## Evidence audit boundaries
KAHRELUM's frozen retrospective benchmark package and audit summaries are available through the public repository. A reproduced score or hash does not demonstrate prospective superiority, independent customer validation or a guarantee of outcomes. The preferred next validation step is an externally controlled prospective evaluation with predefined cases, cutoffs, gold outcomes and acceptance criteria.
